internal-package-contract.help:
Usage: internal-package-contract [command] [options]

Start:
  init                       bring the package here under the standard, or start a new one with --name <package>
  doctor                     what is set up, what to run next, and the steps only a person can take

Daily:
  (none)                     run the whole contract
  generate                   write the generated regions of the documents from package.json and docs/surface.json
  skill                      write the package's agent skill: a short manual an AI loads, and a reference of every public signature
  mutation                   mutation-test what a change touched, as a fast loop (the full run is the check)
  report                     what this change does to the package, as Markdown to paste into a pull request
  env                        document the variables and secrets the package needs, from ci/env.schema.ts
  tool                       run a build or release helper: size, badges, api-report, cjs-interop, compiler-isolation
  add                        wire a new subpath export into every place that lists one, or turn on an optional check
  new                        start a decision record with the next number, its sections and prompts
  promote                    make a check fail the run; --all ends adoption mode

Maintain:
  verify-consumers           check that this version of the standard does not make a package that depends on it worse
  upgrade                    move to a release and bring everything it owns up to date
  sync                       report the files this package owns that are missing or drifted
  site                       generate the landing page and one-page brief from docs/site.json
  exceptions                 list every exception registry: counts by type, legacy, expired
  update-baseline            regenerate the API and surface baselines after a release
  sync-benchmark-guides      copy the canonical benchmark guides into benchmarks/
  install-hooks              point git at the bundled hooks (once per clone)

Run `internal-package-contract <command> --help` for a command's options.

Options (when running the contract):
  --checks a,b               run only checks a and b (and what they depend on)
  --skip a,b                 run every check except a and b
  --changed                  run only the checks the changed files can affect
  --json                     print the report as JSON on stdout and nothing else
  --logs <mode>              write a log per check: all, failing or off (default: failing)
  --strict                   also fail on a "not evaluated" result no exception covers (the default under CI)
  --no-strict                turn --strict off under CI
  -h, --help                 print this text and exit

./config/secretlint.//: Baseline secretlint config -- the default the SecuritySecrets check uses when a consumer has no .secretlintrc.* of its own. @secretlint/secretlint-rule-preset-recommend ships with internal-package-contract.
